title: Automatic Pairwise Statistical Testing for Continuous and Categorical Outcomes
Automatic Pairwise Statistical Testing for Continuous and Categorical Outcomes
text: Compares continuous outcome across every pair independent groups. pair, uses observations two groups two unpaired samples automatically selects: Welch two-sample t-test Shapiro-Wilk normality rejected either complete group (p > 0.05) Wilcoxon rank-sum otherwise Shapiro-Wilk computed complete group, separately every pair. p-value 0.05 indicates normality rejected; establish normality.
code: library(autopairtest)  set.seed(1) df <- data.frame(   value = c(rnorm(20, 5), rnorm(20, 6), rnorm(20, 5.5)),   grp   = rep(c("A", "B", "C"), each = 20) )  pairwise_auto_test(df, value, grp) #> # A tibble: 3 × 8 #>   group_1    n_1 shapiro_p_1 group_2    n_2 shapiro_p_2 test_used    p_value #>   <chr>    <int>       <dbl> <chr>    <int>       <dbl> <chr>          <dbl> #> 1 A           20       0.715 B           20       0.550 Welch t-test  0.0126 #> 2 A           20       0.715 C           20       0.929 Welch t-test  0.482 #> 3 B           20       0.550 C           20       0.929 Welch t-test  0.0740

title: Automatic Pairwise Statistical Testing for Continuous and Categorical Outcomes
text: Compares categorical outcome across every pair independent groups. pair, builds group--outcome contingency table automatically selects: Chi-square test expected cell counts ≥ 5 Fisher’s exact test expected cell count < 5
code: set.seed(42) df <- data.frame(   result = sample(c("Yes", "No"), 90, replace = TRUE),   grp    = rep(c("A", "B", "C"), each = 30) )  pairwise_auto_cat_test(df, result, grp) #> # A tibble: 3 × 6 #>   group_1    n_1 group_2    n_2 test_used       p_value #>   <chr>    <int> <chr>    <int> <chr>             <dbl> #> 1 A           30 B           30 Chi-square Test   0.433 #> 2 A           30 C           30 Chi-square Test   0.806 #> 3 B           30 C           30 Chi-square Test   0.614

title: Automatic Pairwise Statistical Testing for Continuous and Categorical Outcomes
text: functions use tidy evaluation — pass column names unquoted. NA values outcome group dropped via drop_na() analysis. Shapiro-Wilk computed 3 ≤ n ≤ 5,000; outside range shapiro_p NA Wilcoxon used. returned p-values raw (unadjusted); apply multiplicity correction separately appropriate.

title: Automatic Pairwise Statistical Testing for Continuous and Categorical Outcomes
text: existing names retained backward compatibility. pairwise_auto_cat_test() already signals categorical outcomes, pairwise_auto_test() less specific. future major release consider explicit name pairwise_auto_cont_test(), keeping pairwise_auto_test() deprecated alias. Renaming now break existing user code necessary outcome type independent-sample design documented clearly.

what: autopairtest: Automatic Pairwise Statistical Testing for Continuous and Categorical Outcomes — autopairtest-package
title: autopairtest: Automatic Pairwise Statistical Testing for Continuous and Categorical Outcomes — autopairtest-package
text: Provides two functions automatic, unpaired pairwise comparisons independent groups. 'pairwise_auto_test()' compares continuous outcomes pairs groups, automatically selecting Welch t-test (groups pass Shapiro-Wilk normality) Wilcoxon rank-sum test. 'pairwise_auto_cat_test()' compares categorical outcomes, automatically selecting chi-square Fisher's exact test based expected cell counts.
